title: zoe group review --request-file (design-conformance review)
description: Output contract of the design-conformance review (TGD §11.2). Produced by a reviewer in an independent context and submitted by the host; the runtime validates it. Invalid output is recorded as `invalid` and rejected — it never becomes a pass. Every required acceptance id must appear exactly once, every evidence ref must resolve to a record of *this* integration version, and `subject_sha`/`design_digest` must match the frozen group.

subject_sha.description: Must equal the group's current integration_sha. A review of an older version is not a review of this delivery.

design_digest.description: Must equal the frozen design manifest digest.

reviewer.description: Who produced the review. `independent_context` is a declaration, not a proof; the runtime records it and never upgrades it to a guarantee.

acceptance_id.description: Must be one of the acceptance ids mapped by the frozen plan.

status.description: PASS / FAIL / NOT_VERIFIED. There is no 'skipped': an unchecked item is NOT_VERIFIED, and NOT_VERIFIED never counts as passing.

finding.description: Required for FAIL and NOT_VERIFIED: what is wrong, or what could not be judged.

locations.description: Repository-relative paths only. Absolute paths and '..' escapes are refused.

evidence_refs.description: check:<id> (PASS on this subject), group:<subject_sha>, or task:<task_id> (a member integrated into this subject). Fabricated refs are rejected exactly like missing ones.

suggested_action.description: Advisory only: never executed as a shell command.
